bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
page_notes: Science fiction. FEW-BALLOONS case: 6 balloons, no captions. Clean upper-case lettering with bold-italic emphasis words (WE, TOUGH!, WOMEN, I'VE GOT AN IDEA!). The question mark after THEY in region 6 is drawn in a stylised zig-zag form.

regions.text: SO THESE ARE THE TERRIBLE SPACE-BUSTERS, EH? YOU'LL BE AS TAME AS KITTENS WHEN WE GET THROUGH WITH YOU!
regions.notes: Lettered 'SPACE-' / 'BUSTERS' across a line break; the team name is hyphenated, so the hyphen is kept (SPACE-BUSTERS). 'WE' is bold italic.

regions.text: I'M EXHAUSTED! NOT A WORD OUT OF ANY OF THEM! AS SOON AS IT'S DAYLIGHT, WE'LL SHOOT THE VERMIN!
WHAT A WORKING-OVER! IT'LL BE A PLEASURE TO BE SHOT!
regions.notes: Lettered 'WORKING-' / 'OVER!' across a line break; kept as the hyphenated compound WORKING-OVER.

regions.text: I'M NOT LETTING THESE BLASTED AMAZONS SHOOT ME WITHOUT TRYING TO DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT FIRST!
NOT A CHANCE, CAPTAIN! THEY'VE GOT GUARDS ALL OVER THE PLACE! AND THESE BABES ARE TOUGH!
regions.notes: 'TOUGH!' is bold italic, on its own line.

regions.text: SURE, THEY'RE TOUGH! BUT THEY'RE WOMEN, AREN'T THEY? I'VE GOT AN IDEA!
regions.notes: 'WOMEN' and 'I'VE GOT AN IDEA!' are bold italic. The '?' after THEY is a stylised glyph that can look like a 'z' with a dot.
